rows.coder_note: 'FinnGen project' with endpoint counts 14,759 cases and 111,583 controls and no release number; exact counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rules D, I1), and the total equals no FinnGen release N.

rows.quote: Methods We utilized pQTL data from DECODE Genetics, covering 35,559 proteins in 4,907 individuals.
rows.coder_note: deCODE with 35,559 and 4,907: the release N (35,559) and the panel size (4,907 aptamers) of Ferkingstad 2021; the Eldjarn 2023 deCODE row shares 4,907 but has N 35,892, so the pair matches this row only. The sentence attaches the two numbers to the wrong nouns ('35,559 proteins in 4,907 individuals'); coded on the pair of exact values, and a reviewer who reads the sentence literally would leave the row release_not_identified.
